458705.overview:
Kirby and the Forgotten Land: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World includes Kirby and the Forgotten Land, improved graphics and frame rate throughout, plus a new story: Star Crossed World.

After the world is struck by a powerful meteor, Kirby must use his amazing abilities, including some all-new Mouthful Modes to clear a trail through uncharted territory in this exciting adventure.

464212.overview: Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for competition! Take on your rivals in frantic arena battles or fast-paced races on the ground and in the air. Use the Boost Charge button to brake and control your turns as your machine automatically fights for top speed. Fill your Boost Charge Gauge as you drift around the bend and release it to trigger an explosive dash! Choose from a variety of riders like Kirby, Meta Knight, King Dedede, and Magolor from the Kirby’s Return to Dream Land game, and machines including the Warp Star, Wheelie Bike, Chariot, and more. Each machine handles differently, and each rider has their own set of stats and Specials—they can also grab Copy Abilities off their foes to get an edge in the fray. Take on highly varied arena battles in City Trial, or race to the finish in Air Ride Zip around the city of Skyah in City Trial: a free-for-all battle for 16 players online or 8 players via local wireless. Roam around Skyah to find machines, collect power-ups, and survive through unpredictable Field Events ranging from falling meteors to powerful boss battles.

467676.overview:
Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess is a brand-new title which upholds Capcom’s legacy of original and innovative works. This labor of love follows in the tradition of truly unique titles such as Okami and Shinsekai: Into the Depths.

Explore an incredible world in which traditional Japanese aesthetics are brought to stunning life by the power of RE Engine. Enjoy a unique gameplay experience blending action and strategy. Witness an epic clash between the spirit realm and mortal man.

Story

A new tale of the Kami awaits…

This sacred mountain has been defiled by the people who dwell upon it.

Their defilement spreads across the land as a physical blight, beckoning forth foul creatures called the Seethe.

The Spirit Stone Maiden is prepared to perform a rite of cleansing, but she needs a guide to clear her path…

467786.overview:
This is the vast Netherworld, where countless demons vie for supremacy. In one of these many Netherworlds, a veteran mercenary named Nueur is summoned by the Superlative Netherworld overlord Tisiel, who has a shocking request.

“Someone ate the pudding from the refrigerator!”

The pudding in question is the First Radiance Pudding, created by Tisiel’s now-deceased father, the former Superlative Overlord. It was eaten by a subordinate who staged a rebellion, and Tisiel wants it back.

Thus begins the battle to reclaim the First Radiance Pudding, led by a lone mercenary and a fledgling overlord...!

Kyouran Makaism is a brand-new 3D action RPG from an all-star team consisting of director Shunsuke Minowa, character designer Takehito Harada, and composer Tenpei Sato.

In this game, players will be able to experience the exhilaration of defeating enemies with overwhelming power that defies convention - unleashing flashy techniques with simple controls, completionist elements like leveling characters up to 9,999 and “reincarnating” them to grow even stronger, and developing overpowered stats that let them deal over a billion damage.
